name: Kagamine Rin
source:
A young female virtual singer known for the large bow that she wears in her blonde bob hair, and is part of a vocalist pair along with [url=/c128213]Kagamine Len[/url]. She sings with a charming voice befitting of her cute and energetic appearance.

[From in-game profile]
